purpose: Inventory every admitted ARC2 and ARC3 source file by dialect, split role, answer visibility, development usage, contamination, materialization, and access boundary without processing source payloads or freezing PH-D01B content manifests.

X.coordinate: Source admission and contamination metadata before content, acquisition, and environment manifest freeze or any trajectory normalization
inputs: PH-D00B scope and behavior boundary evidence
exact ARC2 and ARC3 distribution identities declared by the HDS distillation specification
ARC3 raw teacher recording locator manifest metadata
X.change_scope: PH-D01A source-profile schema, declarative admission plan, profiles, deterministic inventory compiler, tests, report, preinventory, phase evidence, and documentation for this isolated distillation namespace only.

R.risk: An omitted file, duplicate profile assignment, unknown split or answer visibility, hidden evaluation-answer consumption, policy-weight admission, or environment-source access leak would contaminate every downstream distillation claim.
R.required_response: Fail closed on unknown fields or enums, missing or duplicate source IDs, candidate-path drift, profile-digest mismatch, implicit evaluation contamination, policy-weight admission, environment-source access outside replay, or a report that claims PH-D01B freeze.
R.claim_boundary: PH_D01A_SOURCE_INVENTORY_PASS establishes metadata classification only. It does not establish source-content identity, acquisition reproducibility, environment closure, trajectory normalization, causal evidence, Rule promotion, Bridge readiness, AGI capability, or official readiness.

Mc.mechanism: Strict SourceProfile JSON, an explicit source-admission plan, Git path-set and archive-member-set membership checks, raw-recording locator reconciliation, unique source IDs, deterministic canonical JSON, and a report rebuilt without loading ARC payload contents.
Mc.owner_authority: 大平鉄兵 remains the sole Rule, promotion, bundle, locked-final, official, and submission decision authority.
Mc.rollback: Revert PH-D01A-owned commits only; preserve all pre-existing P22/CV worktree changes and all read-only source assets.

scope: define the six permitted ARC2 and ARC3 source profile types
define the six permitted split roles and explicit answer-visibility, development-usage, contamination, materialization, and source-code-access states
inventory five admitted ARC2 source archive members and exclude sample_submission.json
inventory all fifty Git-tracked ARC3 environment-source files as replay-only source
inventory twenty-five raw winning recording locators as consumed public evaluation distillation source
inventory three retained canonical trajectory/corpus files as consumed public evaluation distillation source
exclude historical policy bundles, derived evidence datasets, runtime reports, and policy graphs from teacher-source admission
record the ARC3 distribution archive environment paths as aliases rather than duplicate source IDs
generate a deterministic source inventory with one and only one profile assignment per admitted source file
non_goals: PH-D01B SourceContentManifest, AcquisitionRecord, EnvironmentManifest, directory Merkle root, wheel hash, seed lock, or read-only freeze
copying external archives or recordings into the repository
ARC2 task parsing or ARC3 source-code execution
trajectory normalization, replay, or semantic interpretation
Causal IR, HypothesisIR, candidate generation, exact fit, or intervention
test_contract: DG-00 source coordinate, admission universe, and profile assignment are explicit and unique
DG-06 distribution, split, answer visibility, use, materialization, contamination, and missing-source states are explicit
DG-09 metadata classification is not presented as causal, capability, or source-freeze evidence
all admitted source IDs occur exactly once across all profiles
unknown profile type, split role, answer visibility, usage, contamination, materialization, access policy, or field fails closed
public evaluation answer or trajectory consumption without PUBLIC_EVALUATION_CONSUMED and explicit contamination fails closed
environment source without REPLAY_HARNESS_ONLY access fails closed
policy-weight admission fails closed and admitted policy-weight count remains zero
Git-tracked candidate path-set drift and raw-recording locator drift fail closed
the five ARC2 source members, fifty ARC3 environment files, twenty-five raw recordings, and three canonical trajectory files are all classified
source payloads are never imported, executed, replayed, or semantically parsed
dedicated tests pass before focused rev3 and D00A/D00B regressions
ruff, strict mypy, compileall, full unit, and integration regressions pass
inventory generation is byte-identical across three independent processes
stop_condition: Suspend on an unclassifiable admitted source, candidate-path drift, missing required profile metadata, implicit contamination, policy-weight admission, required-test unavailability, or any source payload execution. Otherwise bind PH-D01A evidence and continue to PH-D01B as a separate Work Block under recorded Owner authorization.
